messages:
Alison: Morning — day 1! Quick q about security setup: do I need to enroll my personal Mac in MDM or should I wait for a corporate laptop? Also when's the phishing sim and the security training due? Thanks!

Devin: Congrats and welcome 🎉 You should get a corp laptop from ops by EOD, but if you need to use personal temporarily you must enroll it in MDM (Intune) and enable FileVault + 2FA. Onboarding doc: https://intranet.redwood/ops/onboarding-security Training: https://learning.redwood/security-training — complete within 7 days. Phishsim runs monthly; next one is Wed 2026-04-01. If you need an exception ping @Marta.

Jordan: A couple quick checks for macs — run in Terminal: ```fdesetup status``` should return "FileVault is On." Also run: ```/usr/bin/profiles status -type enrollment``` to verify MDM. If you see "No profiles installed" or weird errors paste outputs here and we'll help. :mag_right:

Alison: Thanks! I haven't got the corp laptop yet — what's the MDM enrollment flow? Is it a pushed profile or do I get an email/link?

Devin: For personal devices we'll send an enrollment email from Intune. Click the link, install Company Portal, follow the prompts. Corp laptops arrive pre-enrolled. Also make sure you enable a passcode/TouchID. I'll DM ops to bump your hardware request.

secops-bot: Reminder: All new hires must complete "Security Foundations" training within 7 days. Phishing simulation scheduled: 2026-04-01 09:00 PT.

Marta: I'll grab your hardware case number @Alison and loop ops. I can also do a 15m screen-share to walk through MDM enrollment if helpful — when are you free? :calendar:

Alison: Free after 2pm PT today. One more q: will enrolling my personal device block access to Slack/GDrive until the MDM is approved?

Jordan: Good q — Slack/GDrive SSO is provisioned on hire and should work immediately. Certain sensitive resources (vaults, some internal apps) enforce device compliance and will be blocked until MDM + encryption checks pass.

Alison: Perfect, thanks all :raised_hands:
